name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Provides free additional foodgrains to Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration card holders under the National Food Security Act.
benefits: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month in addition to regular PDS entitlement.
application_steps: No separate application needed; automatically applicable to eligible ration card holders
Collect from designated Fair Price Shop
official_source: Department of Food & Public Distribution, Govt. of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses for rural households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.
benefits: Assistance of up to ₹1.30 lakh in plain areas, ₹1.42 lakh in hilly/difficult areas.
application_steps: Check SECC 2011 list inclusion or apply via Awaassoft/local Gram Panchayat
Fund release in installments linked to construction stage
official_source: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt. of India

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Scholarship to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent dropout at class 8 level and encourage continuation to secondary stage.
official_source: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support to landholding farmer families across the country.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank account.
application_steps: Register on PM-KISAN portal or via CSC/local revenue office
Provide land record and bank details
official_source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension for persons with severe/multiple disabilities (80% or more) living below poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension amount (varies by state, typically ₹300-1000, with state top-ups).
application_steps: Apply at Gram Panchayat/Municipal office or state social welfare portal
official_source: Ministry of Rural Development, Govt. of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Cash incentive for pregnant and lactating mothers for first living child, to improve health-seeking behavior.
benefits: ₹5,000 in three installments, plus ₹1,000 under Janani Suraksha Yojana for institutional delivery.
required_documents: MCP card (Mother and Child Protection card)
application_steps: Submit application form 1A/1B/1C at different stages
DBT to bank account in installments
official_source: Ministry of Women & Child Development, Govt. of India

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) Ration Card
description: Targeted PDS scheme for the poorest of poor households providing highly subsidized foodgrains.
benefits: 35 kg foodgrain per household per month at highly subsidized rates (₹2/kg wheat, ₹3/kg rice approx.).
application_steps: Apply at Tehsil/Taluk office or state PDS portal
official_source: Department of Food & Public Distribution, Govt. of India
